synopsis.native: Odile soupçonne Jean, son mari, de la tromper. Elle décide de lui rendre la pareille et accomplit sa vengeance dans les bras de Daniel, qui, lui, partage la vie d’Albert. Un amour irrépressible, inattendu et tragique naît entre Odile et Daniel…
synopsis.english: Odile suspects that her husband Jean is cheating on her. She decides to give him a taste of his medicine and carries out her revenge with Daniel, who share his life with Albert. An irrepressible, unexpected, and tragic love develops between Odile and Daniel.
